patch_description: This crossover retains the individually parameterized RY layer and expressive per-wire pre-entanglement RZ rotations from the higher-validation chain architecture. It combines them with parity-shared post-entanglement RZ parameters from the current program to regularize the circuit and reduce parameter count. The open CZ chain removes the costly ring-closing gate, lowering depth and gate count while preserving connectivity across all eight qubits. This balances validation accuracy, convergence speed, and generalization more effectively than either fully shared or fully independent RZ layers.
